purpose: Continuation/audit index over canonical artifacts and state; never a policy authority or second artifact store.
invariants: Do not store full chat transcripts as the ledger.
Do not duplicate canonical policy/config/schema or large media.
References point to canonical artifacts/state; the ledger does not replace them.
Approval/policy fields are evidence references, not authorization decisions.
Sensitive values are referenced only through approved redacted/private handles.
Retention and deletion follow Stage 7D classification; this draft authorizes no deletion.

candidate_fields.meaning: canonical or external source references with provenance
references to decisions and rationale artifacts
outputs by reference, not embedded large bytes
open blockers with exact impact and closure action
single resume point when work is not closed
existing VelvetOS state vocabulary when relevant
must resolve through Stage 7D retention rules before implementation

verification_design.references: all referenced canonical artifacts must resolve or be explicitly unavailable
verification_design.exact_bindings: hashes must match the artifact they claim to bind
verification_design.no_authority: ledger state cannot satisfy a policy gate by itself
verification_design.retention: implementation blocked until Stage 7D assigns storage/retention classes

rollback: Delete the ledger index/adapters; canonical artifacts and state remain intact because the ledger never owns them.
